definitions.explanation: A count of three people, using the Sino-Japanese number with the counter for people.

examples.english: The three of us will go.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{三人|さんにん}います。
{三人|さんにん}の{学生|がくせい}がこの{問題|もんだい}に{答|こた}えた。

notes:
{三人|さんにん} uses the Sino-Japanese number {三|さん} with the counter {人|にん} for people.

COUNTING PEOPLE:
The readings for one and two people are irregular: {一人|ひとり}, {二人|ふたり}. From three onward, the regular Sino-Japanese system is used: {三人|さんにん}, {四人|よにん}, {五人|ごにん}.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {三人|さんにん}で: as a group of three
- {三人|さんにん}とも: all three people
- {三人|さんにん}{兄弟|きょうだい}: three siblings
- {三人|さんにん}{組|ぐみ}: a trio, group of three
- {三人|さんにん}{前|まえ}: three servings (food)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The expression {三人|さんにん}{寄|よ}れば{文殊|もんじゅ}の{知恵|ちえ} ("three heads are better than one") is a well-known proverb.
